understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate each level’s grid to reach and activate every goal cell. A goal only completes when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s required shape/color/rotation at the moment you step onto the goal tile; completing all goals advances to the next level, and winning all levels completes the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move (N/S/E/W) costs 1 stamina; when stamina hits 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to max, and losing all lives ends the game (GAME_OVER). Walls block movement and each turn provides blocked_directions that must not be chosen (attempting them wastes a turn/stamina). Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece: shape cycles 0–5 (wrap), color cycles orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation advances 90° clockwise (0→90→180→270→0). A goal activates only when all three attributes match simultaneously; then stepping onto it completes it. Stamina refill tiles restore stamina.
